text:
maya: Quick question — I took a bunch of onboarding notes in my personal Notion page ("maya-ramp"). Where should I put them so the product team can reuse them?

devex-bot: Heads up — common pattern: move personal notes into your team space and apply the 'Onboarding Note' template. See docs: https://redwood.docs/notion-guides (internal).

jon: We generally prefer moving the page into Product > Onboarding > Ramps. That way it shows up in the team nav and we can link it from playbooks. If you want me to move it I can — just share the page with me.

maya: Can you share the quick steps? I'm not super familiar with the Notion move flow.

liz: Steps (quick):
1) Open your page > click the ••• menu in the top-right
2) Select "Move to" and pick workspace "Product" > folder "Onboarding"
3) Apply the template: click the "Templates" button in the top-right of the page > choose "Onboarding Note"
You can also copy the content into the template if you want to keep the original in your personal area.

liz: If you don't have permission to move into Product, request edit access with this short form: https://redwood.workflows/perm-request — pick "Move page into team space" and include the page link. I can approve quickly. :thumbsup:

maria: Also — please use these frontmatter fields at the top of the page so search and evals pick it up: 
- Owner: <your-name>
- Squad: Product
- Week: week-of-YYYY-MM-DD
(we keep them as plain text in the top block)

alex: For external contractors: if any notes include customer PII or contractor-only info, tag the page with "sensitive" and mention me or file a guest-access request (same perm form but choose "Guest access/Contractor"). We avoid moving sensitive content into public team spaces.

maya: Thanks — will move now and use the template + add the frontmatter. Tagging @liz so she can approve if the form is needed.

liz: Cool — ping me once you submit the form if it errors. Also FYI we periodically consolidate ramp notes into a canonical "New Hire Digest" doc (monthly). If yours is useful we might merge it. :sparkles:

maya: Great, thanks everyone!
